title: DeepMCNN neural network diagnoses malaria on thick blood films from routine labels
summary: A convolutional neural network, DeepMCNN, was trained on routine clinical-microscopy labels from quality-controlled clinics in Ibadan, Nigeria, and also reports parasite and white blood cell counts for parasitemia estimation. In prospective validation against expert-level diagnosis it reached sensitivity 0.92 and specificity 0.90, with positive and negative predictive values of 0.92 and 0.90. Evaluation was in a single holoendemic urban setting.
ai_technology: Deep Malaria Convolutional Neural Network (DeepMCNN) classifier on thick blood film images
